يستدركوا (form X)
# يَسْتَدْرِكُوا (yastadrikū) /jas.tad.ri.kuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَدْرَكَ (istadraka)
# يُسْتَدْرَكُوا (yustadrakū) /jus.tad.ra.kuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَدْرَكَ (istadraka)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
